ai.seo_question: What is the significance of visiting graves in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, visiting graves (Ziyarat al-Qubur) is not merely a ritual but a profound spiritual practice intended to awaken the heart to mortality and the Hereafter. This act serves as a practical reminder of the transient nature of worldly life, encouraging believers to prepare for their own eventual return to the earth, a theme deeply rooted in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt.
